diseases.name: Alzheimer's Disease
diseases.summary: Progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by extracellular amyloid-beta plaques, intracellular neurofibrillary tau tangles, chronic neuroinflammation, and impaired cerebral glucose metabolism.

candidates.mechanism: AMPK activation improves neuronal metabolic resilience, reduces tau hyperphosphorylation via GSK3β inhibition, and suppresses microglial neuroinflammation.

supporting_papers.title: Metformin ameliorates amyloid-beta-induced memory impairment and reduces neuroinflammation via AMPK activation
Metformin treatment is associated with reduced dementia incidence in large electronic health records cohort
supporting_papers.citation: Shi, Q. et al. (2021) Lancet Healthy Longev, 2(11):e712-e722.

supporting_papers.title: Effects of Metformin on cerebral glucose metabolism in mild cognitive impairment: Phase II biomarker analysis
supporting_papers.citation: Koenig, A. M. et al. (2022) JAMA Neurol, 79(6):592-602.

clinical_trials.title: Metformin in Preventing Cognitive Decline in Older Adults (MAP4AD)
Pilot Study of Metformin in Amnestic Mild Cognitive Impairment

safety_signals: Monitor renal function (eGFR < 30 mL/min contraindicated due to lactic acidosis risk)
Long-term use may reduce Vitamin B12 absorption; monitor serum levels in elderly patients
limitations: Clinical benefit may depend on baseline metabolic/glycemic status
Optimal blood-brain barrier penetration dosing remains under investigation
Not an approved therapy for Alzheimer's disease; investigational candidate only

candidates.mechanism: Selective Rho-kinase (ROCK1/ROCK2) inhibitor that promotes neurite outgrowth, enhances amyloid-beta clearance by microglia, and reduces cerebral endothelial leakage.

supporting_papers.title: Fasudil improves cognition and reduces neurofibrillary pathology via ROCK inhibition in Alzheimer murine models
supporting_papers.citation: Tatenhorst, L. et al. (2018) Acta Neuropathol Commun, 6:128.

supporting_papers.title: Targeting Rho kinase for neuroprotection and axonal regeneration in neurodegenerative diseases
supporting_papers.citation: Koch, J. C. et al. (2021) Nat Rev Drug Discov, 20(10):768-788.

clinical_trials.title: Phase II Trial of Oral Fasudil in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis and Early Tauopathy

safety_signals: Transient hypotension and cerebral vasodilation require hemodynamic monitoring
Bleeding risk elevation when combined with antiplatelet/anticoagulant agents
limitations: Primary clinical evidence derived from cerebral vasospasm; long-term oral CNS data in chronic dementia cohorts is limited
Human neuroprotection endpoints require prospective Phase III confirmation

candidates.mechanism: PPARα nuclear receptor agonist activating hepatic and microglial lipid catabolism, attenuating neuroinflammation, and enhancing amyloid peptide degradation.

supporting_papers.title: PPARα activation by fenofibrate clears amyloid-beta plaques through autophagic activation in APP/PS1 mice
supporting_papers.citation: Luo, R. et al. (2020) Biol Psychiatry, 88(4):344-356.

clinical_trials.title: Fenofibrate in Mild Cognitive Impairment Biomarker Study

safety_signals: Hepatotoxicity risk; baseline and periodic liver transaminase monitoring required
Elevated rhabdomyolysis risk when co-administered with HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (statins)
limitations: Translational gap between transgenic mouse plaque clearance and human cognitive outcome stabilization
Moderate CNS bioavailability requires prodrug or optimized nanoparticle formulations

candidates.mechanism: Allosteric pharmacological chaperone for glucocerebrosidase (GCase), restoring lysosomal hydrolase trafficking and promoting autophagic clearance of protein aggregates.

supporting_papers.title: Ambroxol increases glucocerebrosidase activity and reduces aggregate pathology in neurodegenerative models
supporting_papers.citation: Mullin, S. et al. (2020) JAMA Neurol, 77(4):427-434.

clinical_trials.title: Ambroxol in Disease Modification of Parkinson's and Lewy Body Dementia

safety_signals: High doses (>1000 mg/day) required for brain chaperone efficacy may cause gastrointestinal discomfort
limitations: Data primarily robust for GBA-mutant Parkinson's; direct efficacy in sporadic Alzheimer's remains preliminary

diseases.name: Parkinson's Disease
diseases.summary: Neurodegenerative disorder defined by death of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra pars compacta, intracellular alpha-synuclein Lewy bodies, mitochondrial respiratory chain dysfunction, and oxidative stress.

candidates.mechanism: GLP-1 receptor agonist exerting neurotrophic effects, preserving dopaminergic neurons, reducing neuroinflammation, and enhancing mitochondrial biogenesis.

supporting_papers.title: Exenatide once weekly versus placebo in Parkinson's disease: a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial

clinical_trials.title: A Phase 3 Trial of Exenatide in Parkinson's Disease (Exenatide-PD3)

safety_signals: Weight loss and gastrointestinal side effects (nausea/vomiting)
Risk of hypoglycemia if used with sulfonylureas or insulin
limitations: Subcutaneous injection formulation requires patient training or caregiver assistance
Long-term disease arrest vs symptomatic compensation still being analyzed in Phase III

candidates.mechanism: Allosterically activates phosphoglycerate kinase 1 (PGK1), stimulating cellular ATP glycolysis and protecting dopaminergic terminals from bioenergetic collapse.

supporting_papers.title: Enhancing glycolysis attenuates neurodegeneration in models of Parkinson's disease

clinical_trials.title: Safety and Tolerability of Terazosin in Parkinson's Disease

safety_signals: Orthostatic hypotension and syncope hazard, especially in elderly parkinsonian patients with autonomic failure
limitations: Alpha-1 adrenergic antagonism requires slow dose titration to mitigate first-dose postural hypotension

diseases.name: Glioblastoma Multiforme
diseases.summary: Aggressive primary adult brain tumor characterized by high invasive potential, robust microvascular proliferation, chemoresistance to temozolomide, and immunosuppressive microenvironment.

candidates.mechanism: Copper complex (CuET) blocks NPL4-p97 segregase, inducing catastrophic proteotoxic stress selectively in glioma stem cells while overcoming MGMT-mediated temozolomide resistance.

supporting_papers.title: Alcohol-abuse drug disulfiram targets cancer via p97 segregase adaptor NPL4
Phase II study of Disulfiram and Copper gluconate with concurrent Temozolomide in recurrent glioblastoma

clinical_trials.title: Disulfiram and Copper in Patients With Recurrent Temozolomide-Resistant Glioblastoma

safety_signals: Absolute contraindication with alcohol ingestion (severe disulfiram-ethanol flush reaction)
Peripheral neuropathy with prolonged administration; liver function test monitoring required
limitations: Requires concurrent copper supplementation for maximal oncolytic NPL4 complex formation
High variability in oral bioavailability and patient compliance

diseases.name: Diabetic Nephropathy / Type 2 Diabetes
diseases.summary: Microvascular complication characterized by persistent albuminuria, progressive decline in glomerular filtration rate, podocyte apoptosis, and extracellular matrix accumulation.

candidates.mechanism: Non-selective phosphodiesterase inhibitor with hemorrheologic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-fibrotic effects, reducing urinary albumin excretion and preserving eGFR.

supporting_papers.title: Addition of pentoxifylline to renin-angiotensin system blockers reduces eGFR decline in diabetic kidney disease (PREDIAN)
supporting_papers.citation: Navarro-González, J. F. et al. (2015) J Am Soc Nephrol, 26(9):2201-2210.

clinical_trials.title: Pentoxifylline in Diabetic Kidney Disease (VA PENTID)

safety_signals: Dose adjustment needed in severe renal insufficiency (eGFR < 30 mL/min)
limitations: Often requires combination with standard-of-care ACE inhibitors or ARBs rather than standalone monotherapy
